translations.text: Nur der Queuewinkel ist frei. Wähl einen der markierten Winkel.

translations.key: Only the cue angle is open. Pick one of the marked angles.
translations.text: È libero solo l'angolo della stecca. Scegli uno degli angoli segnati.

translations.key: Only the cue angle is open. Pick one of the marked angles.
translations.text: Só o ângulo do taco está livre. Escolhe um dos ângulos marcados.

translations.text: Só o ângulo do taco está livre. Escolha um dos ângulos marcados.

translations.key: Only the cue angle is open. Pick one of the marked angles.
translations.text: キューの角度だけが動かせます。印のついた角度を選ぼう。

translations.key: Only the cue angle is open. Pick one of the marked angles.
translations.text: 큐 각도만 바꿀 수 있어요. 표시된 각도 중 하나를 고르세요.

translations.key: Only the cue angle is open. Pick one of the marked angles.
translations.text: 只有球杆角度可调。选一个标出的角度。

translations.key: Only the cue angle is open. Pick one of the marked angles.
translations.text: Открыт только угол кия. Выбери один из отмеченных углов.

translations.key: Only the cue angle is open. Pick one of the marked angles.
translations.text: زاوية العصا وحدها مفتوحة. اختر إحدى الزوايا المحددة.

translations.key: Every control is open now, and the marks are faint.
translations.text: Ahora todos los controles están libres y las marcas son tenues.

translations.key: Every control is open now, and the marks are faint.
translations.text: Toutes les commandes sont libres maintenant, et les repères sont pâles.

translations.key: Every control is open now, and the marks are faint.
translations.text: Jetzt sind alle Regler frei, und die Markierungen sind blass.

translations.key: Every control is open now, and the marks are faint.
translations.text: Ora tutti i comandi sono liberi e i segni sono tenui.

translations.key: Every control is open now, and the marks are faint.
translations.text: Agora todos os controlos estão livres e as marcas são ténues.

translations.key: Every control is open now, and the marks are faint.
translations.text: Agora todos os controles estão livres e as marcas estão fracas.

translations.key: Every control is open now, and the marks are faint.
translations.text: すべての操作が自由になり、印は薄くなりました。

translations.key: Every control is open now, and the marks are faint.
translations.text: 이제 모든 조작이 열려 있고 표시는 흐려졌어요.

translations.key: Every control is open now, and the marks are faint.
translations.text: 现在所有控制都可调，标记变淡了。

translations.key: Every control is open now, and the marks are faint.
translations.text: Теперь открыты все настройки, а отметки бледные.

translations.key: Every control is open now, and the marks are faint.
translations.text: كل أدوات التحكم مفتوحة الآن، والعلامات باهتة.

translations.key: No marks and nothing locked. Make it on your own to pass.
translations.text: Sin marcas y sin bloqueos. Consíguelo tú solo para aprobar.

translations.key: No marks and nothing locked. Make it on your own to pass.
translations.text: Pas de repères, rien de verrouillé. Réussis-le seul pour valider.

translations.key: No marks and nothing locked. Make it on your own to pass.
translations.text: Keine Markierungen, nichts gesperrt. Schaff es allein, um zu bestehen.

translations.key: No marks and nothing locked. Make it on your own to pass.
translations.text: Nessun segno e niente bloccato. Riuscici da solo per superarla.

translations.key: No marks and nothing locked. Make it on your own to pass.
translations.text: Sem marcas e nada bloqueado. Consegue sozinho para passar.

translations.key: No marks and nothing locked. Make it on your own to pass.
translations.text: Sem marcas e nada bloqueado. Acerte sozinho para passar.

translations.key: No marks and nothing locked. Make it on your own to pass.
translations.text: 印もロックもありません。自分だけで決めて合格しよう。

translations.key: No marks and nothing locked. Make it on your own to pass.
translations.text: 표시도 잠금도 없어요. 혼자 성공해서 통과하세요.

translations.key: No marks and nothing locked. Make it on your own to pass.
translations.text: 没有标记，也不锁定。独立打成就能过关。

translations.key: No marks and nothing locked. Make it on your own to pass.
translations.text: Ни отметок, ни блокировок. Сделай сам, чтобы сдать.

translations.key: No marks and nothing locked. Make it on your own to pass.
translations.text: لا علامات ولا شيء مقفل. نفّذها بنفسك لتجتاز.

translations.key: Same line, the cue ball further back, your lesson stroke set up. Before you shoot, say where the cue ball will go. Then change only the tip height to stop it dead.
translations.text: La misma línea, la blanca más atrás y tu golpe de la lección preparado. Antes de tirar, di adónde irá la blanca. Luego cambia solo la altura del golpe para pararla en seco.

translations.key: Same line, the cue ball further back, your lesson stroke set up. Before you shoot, say where the cue ball will go. Then change only the tip height to stop it dead.
translations.text: Même ligne, la blanche plus en arrière, ton coup de la leçon préparé. Avant de tirer, dis où ira la blanche. Puis change seulement la hauteur de frappe pour l'arrêter net.

translations.key: Same line, the cue ball further back, your lesson stroke set up. Before you shoot, say where the cue ball will go. Then change only the tip height to stop it dead.
translations.text: Dieselbe Linie, die weiße Kugel weiter hinten, dein Stoß aus der Lektion eingestellt. Sag vor dem Stoß, wohin die weiße Kugel laufen wird. Ändere dann nur die Treffhöhe, um sie zu stoppen.

translations.key: Same line, the cue ball further back, your lesson stroke set up. Before you shoot, say where the cue ball will go. Then change only the tip height to stop it dead.
translations.text: Stessa linea, la bianca più indietro, il tuo colpo della lezione pronto. Prima di tirare, di' dove andrà la bianca. Poi cambia solo l'altezza del colpo per fermarla.

translations.key: Same line, the cue ball further back, your lesson stroke set up. Before you shoot, say where the cue ball will go. Then change only the tip height to stop it dead.
translations.text: A mesma linha, a branca mais atrás e a tua tacada da lição preparada. Antes de tacar, diz para onde irá a branca. Depois muda só a altura da tacada para a parar de vez.

translations.key: Same line, the cue ball further back, your lesson stroke set up. Before you shoot, say where the cue ball will go. Then change only the tip height to stop it dead.
translations.text: A mesma linha, a branca mais atrás e a sua tacada da lição preparada. Antes de tacar, diga para onde a branca vai. Depois mude só a altura da tacada para pará-la na hora.

translations.key: Same line, the cue ball further back, your lesson stroke set up. Before you shoot, say where the cue ball will go. Then change only the tip height to stop it dead.
translations.text: 同じライン、手球はもっと後ろ、レッスンの撞き方がセットされています。撞く前に、手球がどこへ行くか言ってみよう。それから撞く高さだけを変えて、ピタッと止めよう。

translations.key: Same line, the cue ball further back, your lesson stroke set up. Before you shoot, say where the cue ball will go. Then change only the tip height to stop it dead.
translations.text: 같은 선, 큐볼은 더 뒤에, 레슨에서 친 그대로 준비돼 있어요. 치기 전에 큐볼이 어디로 갈지 말해 보세요. 그다음 치는 높이만 바꿔서 딱 멈추게 하세요.

translations.key: Same line, the cue ball further back, your lesson stroke set up. Before you shoot, say where the cue ball will go. Then change only the tip height to stop it dead.
translations.text: 同一条线，白球更靠后，已按课上的击球设好。击球前，先说说白球会去哪里。然后只改变击球高度，让它停住。

translations.key: Same line, the cue ball further back, your lesson stroke set up. Before you shoot, say where the cue ball will go. Then change only the tip height to stop it dead.
translations.text: Та же линия, белый шар дальше, твой удар из урока настроен. Прежде чем бить, скажи, куда пойдёт белый шар. Затем измени только высоту удара, чтобы он встал на месте.

translations.key: Same line, the cue ball further back, your lesson stroke set up. Before you shoot, say where the cue ball will go. Then change only the tip height to stop it dead.
translations.text: الخط نفسه، والكرة البيضاء أبعد، وضربتك من الدرس مجهزة. قبل أن تضرب، قل إلى أين ستذهب الكرة البيضاء. ثم غيّر ارتفاع الضربة فقط لتوقفها تمامًا.
